newer_changes_search: Web search (socialjustice.gov.in, PIB, press) for 2025-2026: a revision of SC/ST scholarship income limits for 2026-31 is reported as under consideration (proposals up to Rs 4.5 lakh), not notified. No new pre-matric SC guideline found; 15th-FC schemes extended on the same terms to 30 Sep 2026 or approval. The content already says the guidelines cover 2021-22 to 2025-26 and to check the portal; minor.

findings.note: All three rules match §4.2.1 exactly (SC; full-time class IX-X; income 'should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh' -> <=). Fixtures cover 249,999 / 250,000 / 250,001 and a straddling band. Correct.

Component 2 of the same scheme (children of manual scavengers, tanners/flayers, waste pickers and hazardous cleaners, any caste, classes I-X, no income ceiling, Rs 8,000/yr hosteller) is not covered, so such children are not shown this scheme.
findings.suggestion: Optional: mention Component 2 in content, or add it as a separate scheme later (needs a new field).

findings.note: 'Applications open on NSP every April' is not backed by a quoted fact; the guideline timeline says applications from 1 April to 31 July (table near line 243).
findings.suggestion: Optional: add a fact quoting the timeline.

findings.note: aadhaar and bank_account cite msje; the guideline itself (paras 9.x, Aadhaar-linked bank accounts) supports them directly.
